name: dawidnitka
description: Personal Claude Code marketplace providing foundational development tools, safety guardrails, and pre-configured integrations. Built around opinionated defaults that prioritize safety, code quality, and streamlined workflows.

plugins.name: base
plugins.description: Foundational Claude Code configuration providing safety guardrails, automatic code formatting, MCP server integrations, and opinionated development defaults, plus MR/PR review in an isolated worktree and OpenSpec grill and plan-check steps. The essential starting point for any Claude Code workflow.

plugins.name: coding-tutor
plugins.description: Personalized coding tutorials that use your real codebase for examples, with spaced-repetition quizzes and a commit-triggered learning nudge.

plugins.name: extras
plugins.description: Optional developer tooling split out of base: skill authoring with evals, PR/MR descriptions kept current by a push hook (GitHub and GitLab), and isolated Playwright-managed browser sessions per agent.

plugins.name: openspec-extras
plugins.description: Extra steps for the OpenSpec workflow: grill an idea against the project's specs before proposing it, and check a change's plan against the code before applying it. Needs the OpenSpec CLI 2.1 or newer and its skills.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Start and drive isolated Playwright-managed browser sessions for Claude: preflight, consent-gated install, parallel sessions per agent, stored logins, and opt-in attach to an installed Chrome.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Review a GitLab merge request or GitHub pull request in an isolated worktree: two review waves with coverage ledgers, refutation before anything is drafted, and one review posted only after you accept the drafts. Per-repo rules live in ~/.claude/review-rules/.
